# Test: grove exec handles exit codes correctly
setup_workspace feature bugfix

exec grove add feature
exec grove add bugfix

# Successful command shows success message
exec grove exec --all -- true
stderr 'Executed'

# Failed command continues by default and shows failure count
! exec grove exec --all -- false
stderr 'failed'

# A single target propagates the child exit code without generic root errors
exec sh -c 'grove --plain exec main -- sh -c "echo child-output >&2; exit 3"; test $? -eq 3'
stderr 'child-output'
! stderr 'Error: all executions failed'
! stderr 'Run .*grove --help.*'

# Multiple targets still collapse child failures to exit 1
exec sh -c 'grove --plain exec main feature -- test -f only-in-main.txt; test $? -eq 1'

# --fail-fast stops on first failure
! exec grove --plain exec --all --fail-fast -- false
stderr 'All 1 executions failed'
stderr 'Stopped early, 2 worktrees skipped'

-- only-in-main.txt --
exists
